description_en: Describes the syntax and provides examples for the RemoveImageWatermark operation for image logo removal
description_zh: 本文介绍图像标志擦除RemoveImageWatermark的语法及示例
name: RemoveImageWatermark

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.

The URL cannot contain Chinese characters
parameters.help_zh:
图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。

URL地址中不能包含中文字符
parameters.name: image_url
